authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL bokka explicitly gives Prakrit bokkaḍa goat, Old Gujarati bokaḍaü he-goat and Marathi bokaḍ; it also compares Sanskrit bukka goat and gives Oriya bukā. Selected western Bhil/Bareli bukaḍo/bukəḍi/bukuḍo/bukḍo-type goat forms have the documented stop extension, with ordinary gender/vowel endings retained. The survey generic goat sense is preserved rather than narrowed to male. The u/o variation is qualified; no particular cross-IA donor route or deeper origin of bokka is asserted. Rhotic forms that overlap barkara remain separate. Exact response: bukaḍo.
